question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

His ashes were deposited in a golden ______.
solution: The correct answer is **"urn."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"urn"** refers to a container used for holding the ashes of a person's cremated remains. (भस्‍मकलश (मृत व्‍यक्ति के पार्थिव अवशेष रखने का पात्र); अस्थिकलश) • **Example**: *Sometimes the cremated remains are placed in an **urn**__.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because the sentence is referring to the ashes of someone who has passed away. • The word "golden" is used to describe the material of the urn. • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *His ashes were deposited in a golden __**urn**__.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (earn)** is a verb that means to gain or acquire something through effort or work. It is not related to the context of the sentence. ((पैसा) कमाना) • **Option 3 (yearn)** is a verb that means to have a strong desire or longing for something. It is not related to the context of the sentence. ((किसी दुर्लभ वस्‍तु के लिए) ललकना, लालायित होना, लालसा होना) • **Option 4 (years)** is a noun that refers to a period of time. It is not related to the context of the sentence. (52 सप्ताहों, 12 महीनों या 365 या 366 दिनों विभाजित 1 जनवरी से 31 दिसंबर तक का समय, साल, संवत्‍सर) 39:Tc90, The correct answer is **"Mariner."**
